spec.description: Production Traefik reverse-proxy dashboard for the Docker Compose ecommerce microservices platform. Monitors HTTP throughput, status codes, latency, backend services, open connections, bandwidth and configuration reloads.

spec.title: Requests / sec
spec.description: Total requests passing through the selected Traefik entrypoint.

spec.title: Open Connections
spec.description: Current open connections on the selected entrypoint.

spec.title: Requests by HTTP Status
spec.description: Request rate grouped by HTTP status code.

spec.title: Requests by Method
spec.description: Request rate grouped by HTTP method.

spec.title: Service Request Rate
spec.description: Traffic forwarded by Traefik to backend services.

spec.title: Service Response Time
spec.description: Average response time per backend service.

spec.title: EntryPoint Connections
spec.description: Current open connections grouped by entrypoint.

spec.title: Traefik Config Reloads
spec.description: Configuration reload activity and last reload status.
